quotes.title: HD 147506
quotes.card: HD 147506, also known as HAT-P-2 and formally named Hunor, is a magnitude 8.7 F8 dwarf star that is somewhat larger and hotter than the Sun.
quotes.introduction: The star is approximately 419 light-years from Earth and is positioned near the keystone of Hercules.

notes: HAT-P-2 c: found without a transit, and no paper's row measures its whole orbit together (period, eccentricity, periastron time and an inclination with an error bar) (found by radial velocity)
